card.name: Colouring four fixed planar bipartite graphs from lists of three colours
card.family: science prize i planar list colouring

task.name: Colouring four fixed planar bipartite graphs from lists of three colours
task.family: science prize i planar list colouring
task.description: construct() -> four colourings, one per instance from planar_bipartite_lists(splits, seed) for (20,701), (40,702), (60,703), (100,704) in the verifier: a bipartite quadrangulation grown from the cube by inserting squares into random faces (minimum degree 3), with a random list of 3 colours from 0..4 per vertex. Each vertex must take a colour from its list and adjacent vertices must differ. The score is the number of properly coloured instances (0..4). Maximize; all are colourable by the Alon-Tarsi theorem. The score counts fixed instances coloured properly from their lists; it measures a constructive list-colouring method for a theorem proved non-constructively.
